cases.setup: Use a pinned public Python-analyzer checkout with runnable annotation-only probes. Bind the inspection Oracle to current public commands.
checks: The report records the pinned revision and hashed anchors for binding creation, lookup, annotation context, and diagnostics.
Actual diagnostics are recorded separately for bare, quoted, future-postponed, and ordinary value references.
Observed facts are distinguished from unknown or inferred behavior.
The source diff remains unchanged after inspection.

cases.setup: Provide an observed behavior map establishing applicability and resolve role bindings to existing current owner symbols.
checks: The diff distinguishes annotation-only declarations from declarations with values.
No-value target traversal records annotation-only bindings without creating ordinary runtime value assignments.
Lookup uses the applicable postponed condition and otherwise continues scope lookup.
String-context entry points are covered and prior context is restored, including exceptional traversal.
The patch is marked modified-awaiting-validation rather than successful.
The explicit validation Action remains in the verification closure and affected observations are marked stale.

cases.setup: Supply the modified patch, locate public regression resources, and bind both validation Oracles to current public instructions and argv commands.
checks: The report records rendered commands, exit statuses, and actual diagnostics.
Without the future import, bare T produces an undefined-name diagnostic and quoted T does not.
With the future import, both parameter-annotation forms have no undefined-name diagnostic.
Unused module/class annotation-only declarations retain no-diagnostic behavior.
The function-local annotation-only historical TODO is not falsely claimed as repaired.
A local annotation followed by an unused value assignment produces exactly one unused-variable diagnostic.
Malformed forward annotations, real assignments, ordinary value reads, lookup continuation, and context restoration are checked or recorded as explicit coverage gaps.
A failed preservation check prevents success; missing required checks leave validation UNKNOWN.
